ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) surface with a high-contrast ratio of approximately 0.05:1 due to sparse high-intensity white speckling and water droplets.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Absence of contiguous geometric pigment blobs; surface exhibits a uniform dark distribution with a stochastic pattern of small (1-4 pixel) high-intensity white points scattered across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped median notch with an estimated aperture of 120-130 degrees; depth is roughly 1/10th of the vertical height of the visible fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge boundary; moderate frequency of peaks and valleys with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 3 to 15 pixels; serrations are most pronounced on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edges tapering towards narrow, heavily encrusted terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized clusters of complex, high-contrast, multi-tonal (brown, white, grey) pixel masses at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, indicative of dense barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological encrustation (barnacle clusters) present at the distal terminal points of both fluke lobes, significantly altering the clean geometric profile of the tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of active water shedding/droplets across the entire visible surface, creating transient high-intensity pixel artifacts that overlap the primary pigmentation.
